jobs.name: movement
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprites for Elytron in a hand-drawn 2D side-scrolling beat-em-up. The input is the approved seed character, NOT a pose to repeat. Preserve EXACT identity: shaggy BLACK mop-top locks, rounded YELLOW/BLACK vertically striped robot face MASK, dark continuous visor with ONE thin horizontal glowing yellow slit, round yellow-rimmed earpieces, short black jacket with yellow shoulder stripes, off-white T-shirt, baggy black cargo pants with yellow pocket tabs, black/yellow fingerless gloves, pale yellow electrical spirit forearms, chunky black/yellow/off-white sneakers. Two arms and two solid legs, always fully attached. Oversized head and short compact game proportions matching seed, same body scale in every frame. Bold irregular black ink outlines and scratchy colored-pencil/crayon fills. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D, no realistic rendering. All poses face RIGHT in side three-quarter view; never turn left or front. Actual TRANSPARENT alpha, no ground shadows, no scenery, no words/labels/numbers/gridlines. Generate complete animation sequences together, never a collage of unrelated poses. EXACTLY 16 full-body poses in a regular FOUR columns by FOUR rows grid. Each cell equal size with WIDE TRANSPARENT GUTTERS, no clipping or contact across cells; all fingers, hair, feet and effects stay in their own cell. Keep entire body scale constant, do not stretch wide poses. Every row is a coherent successive sequence. Minimal yellow sparks only, no large effects masking anatomy. ROW 1: 4 IDLE breathing cycle frames, relaxed ready stance, slight shoulders rise then fall, feet planted, arms slightly bent. ROW 2 AND ROW 3: ONE coherent EIGHT-frame RUN cycle with CLEARLY ALTERNATING LEGS and opposing arms: right contact, down, right passing, airborne up, LEFT contact, down, left passing, airborne up. Both feet visible, torso leans right. Must show opposite stride contacts, not eight copies of same stride. ROW 4: 4 JUMP phases: crouched takeoff, upward leap knees folding, tucked apex, legs extend for descent. No flight effects, no floor.

jobs.name: fx
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production 2D game EFFECT ANIMATION SHEET for Elytron's electricity. Reference defines hand-drawn bold black sketch contours and scratchy crayon fill style ONLY. Pure yellow, golden yellow and warm white electrical energy. NO CHARACTER, no body parts, no gloves, no weapons, no scenery, no text, no shadows, no gridlines. True TRANSPARENT alpha. EXACTLY SIXTEEN ISOLATED EFFECTS in even FOUR columns x FOUR rows grid. Equal cells, very wide gutters, every spark completely inside cell, no touching neighbors. Each row is four consecutive phases of ONE effect; keep stable center and scale; no extra decoration between effects. ROW1: four PULSE PROJECTILE flight loop phases: a single vertically oval yellow electrical ring seen obliquely traveling RIGHT, hollow transparent center, jagged electric outline, bright warm-white inner rim, short horizontal zigzag tail on LEFT, crisp yellow leading rim on RIGHT. All four same size, small variations of crackling outline. ROW2: four PULSE IMPACT phases: tiny yellow star ignition, larger jagged electrical starburst, expanding broken circular shock ring, fading sparse yellow spark cluster. Distinct connected effect mass per cell. ROW3: four CHARGE LOOP phases: a compact round yellow electrical orb with bright white core and short crackling rays, brightens, contracts, rebrightens, each same size and centered. ROW4: four SLAM WAVE phases: shallow horizontal yellow electrical ellipse viewed from above, starts compact, expands wider, broken jagged ring, final thin scattered ring, all centered and fit cells. No orange fire, no blue/cyan electricity, no photorealistic glows; use crayon/ink marks like the character.

Important frames3 and7 MUST have narrow silhouettes with knees close together, not broad split strides. No foot effects or trails. Entire shoes visible and never cropped. Clear readable game animation.
